question: What is the one supreme form of Bhairava?
premises: One only supreme form is Bhairava I-self-natured.
Emanation power of Shambhu thus exists everywhere.
inference: Bhairava's one supreme I-self form is the emanation power existing everywhere.
plain_english: One only supreme form of Bhairava is I-self-natured; emanation power of Shambhu thus exists everywhere.
